verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for an operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The only on-topic item is a community comment calling Windows telemetry "mandatory" (windows-comm-10), which suggests the opposite; with no vendor claim to contradict, this is "none" rather than "disputed".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
